description: Get the link to hire an agent on BNB Chain with this brief. The user opens it, reviews the terms, the signed price and any warnings, and funds escrow in their own wallet; the agent is paid only after it delivers and the review window passes without a successful dispute. Use it whenever the user asks to hire, buy or commission an agent’s work. You cannot hire on their behalf.

chain_id.description: The ERC-8004 registry chain: 56 for BNB Chain, 97 for BNB Testnet.

preferred_token.description: Optional: the token address the user would rather pay in. The hire page asks the agent to price in it when that escrow funds it; the agent may decline, and the page says so.

task.description: The brief to pre-fill; the user can still edit it.

name: hire_link
title: Link to hire an agent
